LanguageData.Sanguophage.description: When a dark stranger offered you a cure for your cancer, you were ready to agree to anything. He made you into a vampire - an immortal blood-drinker hated by a thousand religions. You hid your condition for years, but eventually a hunter tracked you down. Stowing away on the first starship leaving the system, you barely escaped alive.\n\nNote: Vampires have unique strengths and weaknesses, which makes this a difficult scenario.
LanguageData.Sanguophage.label: The Vampire
LanguageData.Sanguophage.scenario.summary: One crashlanded vampire needing blood to survive, and one human colonist.
